answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36772 Country: India Title: I dreamt I am offering salah. It was just before Fajr Question: I dreamt I am offering salah. It was just before Fajr. Within a week my mother also dreamt that she is offering salah very properly, taking great care to do all the positions properly and correctly. What does this mean? Answer ID: 36772 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 373/240/D=1433) Ma-sha-Allah, it is a blessed dream. It indicates towards special relation and nearness to Allah. You should specially avoid sins and immodesty and unveiling. Also you should try to offer salah regularly with full dedication and attention. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
